Professional Summary
Backend engineer focused on scalable, reliable services and real-time data pipelines. Experienced in designing and delivering high-throughput systems using Python3 and distributed messaging, with strong practice in containerization and agile delivery.

Technical Skills
Python3, Django, Redis, Docker, Kafka, Agile, Jira, Git

Work Experience

- Designed and implemented a Kafka-based event ingestion pipeline using Python3, improving downstream processing throughput by 4x and reducing end-to-end latency by 35%; used Redis for caching hot lookups to lower DB load.
- Built Dockerized microservices in Python3 that handled auth, billing, and notifications; integrated Kafka topics for async communication and used Redis for session and rate-limit storage.
- Led a cross-functional team in Agile ceremonies via Jira, introducing CI/CD practices with Git-based workflows that cut deployment time by 50% and reduced rollbacks.
- Instrumented services with monitoring and alerting, enabling faster incident response and stable Kafka consumer group performance under peak traffic.

Software Engineer - Backend, Medisure (Nov 2016 - Dec 2018)
- Developed Django-based APIs in Python3 for claims processing, integrating Kafka to stream claim events to downstream analytics and using Redis to cache intermediate computation results.
- Containerized components with Docker and managed deployments with Git-driven pipelines, improving release reliability and enabling repeatable test environments.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints tracked in Jira to deliver incremental features, implemented consumer idempotency and backpressure handling for Kafka consumers to maintain system stability under load.
- Optimized Redis caching strategies and query patterns, reducing average response times for key endpoints by over 40%.
